title: Main Gear Side Stay Lock Link Actuation and Downlock Sensing Rework, VANTOR-68

ata.title: Main Gear — Side Stay and Lock Links

abstract: Rework of the lock link actuation and the downlock proximity sensing of the wing-mounted main gear on the four-engine stretched aircraft, where the heavier landing gear load path made the original overcentre margin marginal in cold conditions.

sections.reason: The VANTOR-68 carries the highest maximum landing weight in the family on a gear geometry shared with lighter variants, and the lock link overcentre margin was set from the lighter case. Six operators reported a total of twenty-three unsafe gear indications during extension at outside air temperatures below minus five degrees Celsius, all of which cleared on recycling. Ground testing at low temperature reproduced the condition: the grease in the lock link joint stiffens enough to leave the link 1.2 degrees short of the overcentre position, which is inside the proximity sensor dead band but outside the certified locked geometry. The condition is specific to the stretched four-engine aircraft; the shorter four-engine variant and the twin-engine aircraft have adequate margin at the same temperature.
sections.description: The lock link actuation is re-worked to increase the overcentre travel by 3.5 degrees and to lower the breakout force at low temperature. The inboard clamp assembly D3210122801088 is replaced by a stiffer item, the inboard heat exchanger sub-assembly D3210122818558 is retained, and the obsolete lower manifold D3210129320861 and forward pump D3210120197201 are deleted with the circuit re-plumbed directly. The outboard solenoid VAD543968-23 is replaced by a unit with a wider operating temperature band, and the lower pump HED997832-72 and the upper non-return valve LUDE897936-82 are removed from the assembly. Proximity sensing is re-targeted: the outboard manifold sensing position 14WS and the forward sensing position 70GM are moved to read the link directly rather than the actuator rod, and the inboard hose position 448GB is re-routed clear of the new travel. The right-hand filter position 9WS8 is retained. Work is done in the main gear bays and the gear doors, zones 721, 731 and 752, with the aircraft on jacks. Detail is on drawings D32100087428 and D32101114402.
sections.effects: Mass reduction of 6.8 kg per aircraft after deletion of the redundant pump and manifold. No electrical load change; the proximity sensing draws the same current from an unchanged interface unit. Not interchangeable, because the lock link geometry and the sensor target positions change together and neither can be embodied alone. The recycling procedure in the flight crew operating manual is unchanged but the cold weather advisory note is withdrawn once embodied. Landing gear swing test content and the associated trouble shooting procedure require update.
sections.embodiment_note: Retrofit only; the VANTOR-68 line closed in 2011. Embodiment is through Service Bulletin SLN-32-1027 with the aircraft on jacks over four days, and it includes a full landing gear swing test. The kit includes the revised clamp, the solenoid and the sensor brackets.

type_data.production_impact: None; the VANTOR-68 line is closed
